caption: A bath towel is folded in half and then in half again.

sa.check: A bath towel is laid out.
It is folded in half again.
The first fold comes before the second.

pc.expect: The towel gets smaller and thicker with each fold, and the halves lie flat on each other.
pc.fail: The towel stays the same size after folding; or it grows; or a fold produces more towel.

pc.expect: The towel bends along the fold line as soft cloth and does not stiffen or stretch.
pc.fail: It is rigid like cardboard; or it stretches; or it snaps.

pc.expect: It folds only as the hands move it.
pc.fail: It folds on its own; or unfolds by itself; or slides.

pc.expect: The layers lie on each other, not through each other.
pc.fail: A layer passes through another; or the hands pass through the towel; or the towel passes through the surface beneath.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The towel's colour and the surface stay the same.
pc.fail: The towel changes colour; or the surface changes; or the background rearranges.

note: The hands are kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
